description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 08.07.2019 to 14.07.2019
categorisation: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs valuation and financial compliance, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
